gui.about.title: About MMEX-Sync
gui.about.content:
MMEX-Sync v0.3.0 (Rust Edition)

Secure and modern Offline-First gateway for Money Manager Ex (MMEX).
Pure AES-256-GCM cryptography, transparent .emb file encryption and multi-backend hexagonal architecture (PocketBase, Supabase, Firebase).
